items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: Winard was interviewed in Utica, New York on October 10, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Winard Harper was born in Baltimore in 1962 and was inspired to pursue jazz drumming when he heard a recording of Clifford Brown and Max Roach. He has performed with Dexter Gordon and Betty Carter, and co-led the Harper Brothers Quintet with his brother Phillip. He is one of the most in-demand drummers in jazz today Winard was interviewed in Utica, New York on October 10, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are at the Hotel Utica and I’m speaking with drummer and band leader Winard Harper. Welcome to Utica.
Hey, thank you. Good to be here.
